title: Oven Roasted Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Saudi Arabian dish featuring plum jam, this recipe is sugar-free-friendly and roasted to perfection, resulting in a crispy exterior and juicy interior. The use of papillote ensures even cooking and a flavorful outcome.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together plum jam, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the plum jam mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Wrap each skewer in foil, creating a papillote, and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the chicken kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the exterior is crispy.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
